body.name: Atomic row-recovery map
body.construction: For \(i\in A\), obtain \(T_i=\partial_x\mathbb E[K_{\{i\}}(x)]\) from the affine kernel and obtain the unordered projective rows \(\mathscr R_i\) of an ICA unmixing matrix for the centered residual law \(K_{\{i\}}(0)\) on \(X\setminus\{i\}\). Lift \([v]\in\mathscr R_i\) by \(\Lambda_i(v,T_i)_{X\setminus\{i\}}=v\) and \(\Lambda_i(v,T_i)_i=-vT_i\). Define \(\rho_i(\Pi_A\mathbf K)\) as the unique element of \(\mathscr R(Q)\setminus\{[\Lambda_i(v,T_i)]:[v]\in\mathscr R_i\}\), normalize its representative \(q_i\) by \((q_i)_i=1\), and return \(\operatorname{rec}_i(\Pi_A\mathbf K)=e_i^\top-q_i\).
